note: Generated by node tools/voice-texts.js sync. Key -> the English text that the mission speaks (CHK checklist rows, DSC dispatch descriptions, templates with {0} {1}). The Mission Companion pack EN holds the same texts; translated packs copy it.

texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.02: Set STANDBY BAT and AVIO Master 1 and 2 Switches ON!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.03: Set Pitot static heating Copilot and pilot switches to ON
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.04: Set LAVCS to Pil or Pax as required!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.05: Set FUEL PRIME PUMP 1 and 2 switches to OFF! Verify on Master list: FUEL1 PRIME PUMP FUEL2 extinguished!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.06: Set Fuel Transfer Pump Aft and Forward switches to ON! Verify on Master list: AFT+FWD FUEL PMP extinguished!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.07: Set external position and strobe lights as required!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.08: Set Internal Emergency Exit lights switch to ARM!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl.09: Verify Avionics, communication and navigation equipment are on as required
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1b.01: After engine start checklist, heating and avionics checks!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.01: After engine start checklist, avionics checks!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.02: Avionics checks. G T N: check data bases valid!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.03: G T N: press continue on both units!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.04: G T N: press continue on both units again!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.05: G T N: set frequencies and transponder as required!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.06: G T N: check heading indication consistent with the M F D, true or magnetic!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.07: All other instruments and equipment: check and set!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl1c.08: Note! Tests to be done before every IFR or, for VFR, at least once a day.
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.01: After engine start checklist, part two!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.02: Engage A P 1, A P 2 and backup!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.03: On the F N D A F C S strip verify 3 green rectangles are displayed!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.05: Preparation for night flight. Choose an option, the checklist waits for it!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.06: Night flight. On the M F Ds adjust luminance!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.08: Fixed and search light landing lights: check function, set as required!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2.09: Check the fabric glare shield is installed!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2b.01: After engine start checklist, part two, part 2!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2b.02: Optional equipment checks. Check as required, refer to section 7 and section 9!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2b.03: Power check. Perform the ground power check as required, refer to section 5!
texts.CHK.afterengstartckl2b.04: Engine main switches: flight, guards closed!
texts.CHK.afterheating2ckl.02: Cockpit fan: verify operation. Feel the airflow by hand at the demisting or instrument panel outlet!
texts.CHK.afterheating2ckl.04: Generator amps: verify decrease, only if the electrical heater is installed!
texts.CHK.afterheating2ckl.05: Cockpit fan: verify it stops. Feel the airflow by hand!
texts.CHK.afterheatingckl.02: Heating system check. Deselect DEFOG DEMIST!
texts.CHK.afterheatingckl.03: On the VMS page press NUM!
texts.CHK.afterheatingckl.05: Heating: set to maximum and check it is on! Check and remember the generator amps!
texts.CHK.afterheatingckl.07: Generator amps: verify increase by approximately 30 amps, only if the electrical heater is installed!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.02: Unlatch collective and push fully down!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.03: Set TEST switch to LAMP and hold. Check MKR Hi, DME1 HOLD, DME2 HOLD, FMS1 OFF and FMS2 OFF lights are on!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.04: Set TEST switch to P-FLT (hold briefly)
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.05: Verify preflight test is running, wait for P-FLT TEST OK indication on Master list!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.06: Engage AP1 and AP2 from cyclic or APCP!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.07: On FND AFCS strip verify 3 green rectangles are displayed for 10 seconds!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.08: Press AP/BKUP CUT switch on cyclic and check AP1 and 2 OFF indications are lighted on APCP. On FND check amber SAS indication appears in 2 locations and AFCS DISENGAGED message is shown
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.09: Press AP/BKUP CUT switch again and check AP1 and 2 OFF indications are lighted on APCP. On FND check red SAS indication appears in 2 locations and AFCS DISENGAGED message is shown
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.10: Check Cyclic beep trim in all directions!
texts.CHK.aviopftckl.11: Center cyclic and set pedals parallel!
texts.CHK.beforetockl.02: Engine one and two main switches. Flight, guards closed.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.03: Rotor speed. Nominal in flight mode.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.05: Outside air temperature below zero. Engine fuel low temperature cautions. Check extinguished.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.08: M F D four and one. Select required page.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.09: I E S I. Check aligned, I A S and altitude valid.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.10: Auto pilot and backup S A S. Check on.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.11: Optional equipment controls. As required. Copilot armrest stowed and cockpit dome light off, if installed.
texts.CHK.beforetockl.12: Night flight. Fixed and secondary landing lights. Check on and adjusted.
texts.CHK.engstartckl.02: Fuel prime pumps 1 and 2 switches ON!
texts.CHK.engstartckl.03: If fire guard is present, post him!
texts.CHK.engstartckl.05: Set both engines 1& 2 MAIN switches to IDLE, wait at least 1 second then set both switches to FLT!
texts.CHK.engstartckl.06: On both Engines monitor N1,TOT,N2,NR parameters increase
texts.CHK.engstartckl.07: Check engine oil, MGB oil and hydraulic oil positive indications!
texts.CHK.engstartckl.08: FND Master list: Check STARTUP TEST OK Appears!
texts.CHK.engstartckl.09: At approximately 60% of N1 verify, on master list, STARTER ON indication is not in view! On VMS No START indication is in view!
texts.CHK.engstartckl.10: N2 and NR: Check in flight mode and matched!
texts.CHK.ifrdep2ckl.03: Navigation source: select according to the S I D!
texts.CHK.ifrdep2ckl.04: Baro settings: check on the F N D and the I E S I!
texts.CHK.ifrdep2ckl.05: Decision height: set on the F N D!
texts.CHK.ifrdep2ckl.07: Departure: normal or category A take off, perform!
texts.CHK.ifrdep2ckl.08: After passing V T O S S, A F C S upper modes as required according to the procedure and flight plan!
texts.CHK.ifrdep2ckl.09: I F R departure checklist complete.
texts.CHK.ifrdepckl.02: In areas served by S B A S, check NOTAMs to verify S B A S availability throughout the flight and during the approach!
texts.CHK.ifrdepckl.03: No S B A S: check R A I M availability on the prediction page!
texts.CHK.ifrhold2ckl.02: Check S U S P indicated on the F N D and the N A V D!
texts.CHK.ifrhold2ckl.03: Check the aircraft follows the holding!
texts.CHK.ifrhold2ckl.04: Unsuspend soft key on the G T N: touch!
texts.CHK.ifrhold2ckl.05: Check S U S P disappears on the F N D and the N A V D!
texts.CHK.ifrhold2ckl.06: Check the aircraft exits the holding!
texts.CHK.ifrholdckl.02: Flight plan on G T N: select!
texts.CHK.ifrholdckl.03: Holding waypoint: touch to select the sub menu!
texts.CHK.ifrholdckl.04: Hold at waypoint soft key: touch!
texts.CHK.ifrholdckl.07: Autopilot navigation mode: couple, if required!
texts.CHK.ifrils2ckl.02: Decision altitude and decision height: set as required!
texts.CHK.ifrils2ckl.04: Autopilot N A V: arm or couple. Not too early, minimum 4 nautical miles!
texts.CHK.ifrils2ckl.05: Localizer indicated less than 2 dots: check A P P appears in the A F C S strip!
texts.CHK.ifrils2ckl.06: Glide slope indicated less than 0.5 dots: check G S appears in the A F C S strip!
texts.CHK.ifrils2ckl.07: At decision altitude: land if visual, otherwise missed approach.
texts.CHK.ifrilsckl.02: Caution! Set the approach course first. Both G T N: set the I L S frequency!
texts.CHK.ifrilsckl.03: Navigation soft key on M F D 1: select I L S 1!
texts.CHK.ifrilsckl.04: Navigation soft key on M F D 2: I L S 2!
texts.CHK.ifrilsckl.05: F N D or N A V D: select the H S I presentation!
texts.CHK.ifrilsckl.06: Course knob on the M F D: set to the final approach course!
texts.CHK.ifrilsckl.07: Baro settings: check on the F N D and the I E S I!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav2ckl.01: L NAV or L P approach, part 2!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav2ckl.02: F N D: check L NAV, L NAV plus V, L P or L P plus V, else missed approach!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav2ckl.03: Airspeed: adjust to the approach airspeed!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav2ckl.04: Autopilot altitude arm, F P A or vertical speed mode: pre select as required!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav3ckl.01: L NAV or L P approach, part 3!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav3ckl.02: Autopilot mode indication on the F N D or N A V D: check A P P indicated!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav3ckl.03: Autopilot altitude arm, F P A or vertical speed mode: activate, as required!
texts.CHK.ifrlnav3ckl.04: At decision altitude: land if visual, otherwise missed approach.
texts.CHK.ifrlnavckl.01: L NAV or L P approach!
texts.CHK.ifrlnavckl.02: Approach procedure: select and activate. If vectors to final are expected, refer to vectors to final!
texts.CHK.ifrlnavckl.03: Navigation mode: G P S or S B A S. G P S means L NAV approach!
texts.CHK.ifrlnavckl.04: Baro settings: check on the F N D and the I E S I!
texts.CHK.ifrlnavckl.05: Decision altitude and height: set to L NAV or L P minima!
texts.CHK.ifrlpv2ckl.02: F N D: check L P V or L V NAV, else missed approach. Only L NAV: use L NAV minima!
texts.CHK.ifrlpv2ckl.03: Airspeed: adjust to the approach airspeed! With the autopilot I A S mode engaged the maximum rate of descent is 1000 feet per minute!
texts.CHK.ifrlpv2ckl.04: Autopilot F P A, track, heading, vertical speed knob: select F P A track!
texts.CHK.ifrlpv2ckl.05: Approach angle: check, it shall match the approach chart!
texts.CHK.ifrlpv2ckl.07: Autopilot: check A P P and V A P P indicated!
texts.CHK.ifrlpv2ckl.08: At decision altitude: land if visual, otherwise missed approach.
texts.CHK.ifrlpvckl.02: Approach procedure: select and activate. If vectors to final are expected, refer to vectors to final!
texts.CHK.ifrlpvckl.03: Navigation mode: G P S or S B A S. G P S means L NAV approach!
texts.CHK.ifrlpvckl.04: Baro settings: check on the F N D and the I E S I!
texts.CHK.ifrlpvckl.05: Decision altitude and height: set to L P V or L NAV V NAV minima!
texts.CHK.ifrmissedckl.02: Flight plan page on the G T N unit: select!
texts.CHK.ifrmissedckl.04: Touch activate G P S missed approach, or push G A on the collective!
texts.CHK.ifrmissedckl.05: At the M A P, check S U S P appears!
texts.CHK.ifrmissedckl.06: G A pushbutton on the collective: push! The autopilot navigation mode remains coupled and automatic waypoint sequencing is provided!
texts.CHK.ifrmissedckl.07: Note! Without G A mode, use the activate missed approach soft key.
texts.CHK.ifrobscancelckl.02: O B S soft key: select the O B S page!
texts.CHK.ifrobscancelckl.03: Enter soft key: touch to de activate the O B S function!
texts.CHK.ifrobscancelckl.04: Note! TO side: direct to waypoint, sequencing unsuspended. FROM side: direct to waypoint, sequencing suspended, use unsuspend.
texts.CHK.ifrobsckl.02: Caution! Flight plan hidden on F N D. O B S soft key: select the O B S page!
texts.CHK.ifrobsckl.03: Course pop up: select the desired course to the O B S waypoint!
texts.CHK.ifrobsckl.04: Enter soft key: touch to activate the O B S function!
texts.CHK.ifrobsckl.05: S U S P appears on F N D. Check O B S and course!
texts.CHK.ifrobsckl.06: Autopilot navigation mode: couple, as required!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelcancelckl.02: Flight plan page on G T N: select!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelcancelckl.03: Menu soft key on the G T N: touch!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelcancelckl.04: Parallel track soft key on the G T N: touch!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelcancelckl.05: Parallel track pop up: enter direction left or right and offset!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.02: Caution! Use N A V D for offset waypoints. Flight plan page on G T N: select!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.03: Menu soft key on the G T N: touch!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.04: Parallel track soft key on the G T N: touch!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.05: Parallel track pop up: enter direction left or right and offset!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.07: Check O F S T appears on the F N D and the N A V D!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.08: Autopilot navigation mode: couple, as required!
texts.CHK.ifrparallelckl.09: Note! Offset waypoints carry the suffix p. Some legs do not support parallel track.
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.02: Approach procedure: select and activate. Select vectors as transition!
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.03: On the from side of the approach S U S P is indicated!
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.04: Navigation mode: G P S or S B A S!
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.05: Baro settings: check on the F N D and the I E S I!
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.06: Decision altitude and height: set to the approach minima!
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.08: Final course intercepted: S U S P disappeared!
texts.CHK.ifrvtfckl.09: Then continue with the L NAV, L P or L P V approach.
texts.CHK.interior2ckl.04: All switches: off or norm, priority norm!
texts.CHK.interior2ckl.05: Instrument panel. Emergency off one and two switches: guarded!
texts.CHK.interior2ckl.06: Engine one and two main switches: off!
texts.CHK.interior2ckl.07: FADEC emergency one and two switches: off and guarded!
texts.CHK.interior3ckl.02: E L T remote control unit. Switch: armed!
texts.CHK.interior3ckl.03: E L T test: hold one second!
texts.CHK.interior3ckl.04: LED and buzzer: one long signal followed in 5 seconds by a short signal, test successful!
texts.CHK.interior4ckl.02: Center console. Static pressure switch: secured!
texts.CHK.interior4ckl.04: Rear camera switch, if installed: off!
texts.CHK.interior4ckl.05: Control panel M F D copilot switch: norm!
texts.CHK.interior4ckl.06: Push for air, defog lever: as required!
texts.CHK.interior4ckl.07: Search light, mirror, H I S L switch: set as required!
texts.CHK.interior4ckl.09: Copilot collective: check the type of collective installed and familiarize with the location of grip and switches!
texts.CHK.interiorckl.02: Baggage, cargo and loose items: stowed and secured!
texts.CHK.interiorckl.03: Hand fire extinguisher: on board, check pressure!
texts.CHK.interiorckl.04: Hand lamp: on board, check function!
texts.CHK.interiorckl.06: Seat and pedals: adjust. Find a comfortable position, the top of the instrument panel at eye level, warning unit fully visible. Then adjust the pedals!
texts.CHK.interiorckl.07: Safety belts: fasten and adjust. Lap belts tight first, then the shoulder harness. Keep the fire pushbuttons within reach!
texts.CHK.interiorckl.08: Pilot and copilot door: latches engaged, green visible. In cold weather, close the heating outlets.
texts.CHK.landingckl.02: Note! Sandy: close NACA inlets. Approach: 100 feet, 40 knots, under 500 per minute!
texts.CHK.landingckl.03: Below 100 feet: slow to 30 knots at 50 feet!
texts.CHK.landingckl.04: After landing. Cyclic stick: neutral position!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.02: Set fuel prime pumps 1 and 2 ON!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.03: If fire guard is present, post him!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.04: Make sure rotor area is clear!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.06: Set Engine 1 or 2 main switch to IDLE and start clock!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.07: Set other Engine main switch to IDLE
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.08: Monitor N1, T O T, N2, Nr parameters increase!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.09: Check engine oil, MGB oil and hydraulic pressures increase!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.10: On master list: check green STARTUP TST OK message is displayed!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.11: FND master list: check STARTUP TST message is displayed!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.12: On master list and VMS: At 60% of N1 verify STARTER ON message is extinguished!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.13: On master list and VMS: At 60% of N1 verify STARTER ON message is extinguished!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.14: At about 78% of Nr, in idle, verify N2 and Nr are matched!
texts.CHK.normengstartckl.15: Verify no system related caution indication is present!
texts.CHK.normhydckl.02: Set TEST HYD switch to SYS1 and hold. Check for LOW PRESS HYD2 on master list and amber HYD2 P on VMS !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.03: Press and hold Cyclic trim release !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.04: Perform small cyclic movements and verify longitudinal and lateral motion !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.05: Perform small  pedals movements and raise collective from 0 to 1 FLI and verify normal forces are required !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.06: Set TEST HYD switch to SYS2 and hold. Check for LOW PRESS HYD1 and HYD TR SHUT OFF on master list and amber HYD1 P on VMS !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.07: Perform small cyclic movements and verify longitudinal and lateral motion !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.08: Perform small pedals movements and raise collective from 0 to 1 FLI and verify normal forces are required !
texts.CHK.normhydckl.10: Set TEST HYD switch to OFF !
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.02: Set Instrument mode switch to DAY or Night or NVG as required!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.03: Set Battery Master Switch to Engage and then On!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.04: On master list, verify the green Power up test OK is in view!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.05: Set Test Fire 1 to , EXT . Verify FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 USED caution is shown on master list !
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.06: Set Test Fire 1 to, EXT, plus Warn. Verify: Engine 1 Fire, FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 TEST mesages are shown on master list! On warning unit, verify FIRE, EXT, BOT 1, BOT 2 lights are on!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.07: Set Test Fire 2 to , EXT. Verify FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 USED caution is shown on master list !
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.08: Set Test Fire 2 to , EXT, plus Warn. Verify: Fire Engine 2, FIRE BOTTLE 1 and 2 TEST mesages are shown on master list! On warning unit, verify FIRE, EXT, BOT 1, BOT 2 lights are on!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.09: Set Test switch to LAMP and hold. Check all indicating lights and EXIT emergency lights are on!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.10: Set Test switch to OFF, make sure all lights return to normal!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.11: On the VMS display: push NUM, softkey, then push Weights and adjust values. Validate and push PREV,!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.12: Verify DC voltage is more than 23.5 Volts, check fuel quantity!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.13: On Master list, Verify ENG,1 FAIL ENG,2 and AFT plus forward Fuel Pump, EPU connected (if connected), Pitot1 heater off pitot 2, power up test ok, messages are displayed! Verify no rotor brake message is in view!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.14: On IESI wait for alignment, then, On MFD and IESI set baro as required!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.15: On cyclic and collective, push and hold trim release! Move flight controls throughout full travel, check for free movement!
texts.CHK.normstartupckl.16: Set anticollision light as required. Note that must be on for engine starting!
texts.CHK.prelandingckl.02: For night flight. Fixed landing light: on!
texts.CHK.prelandingckl.03: Search light landing light: on and adjusted!
texts.CHK.prelandingckl.05: All warnings, cautions and master list: check!
texts.CHK.prelandingckl.06: N 2, N R: 101 percent or more below 50 knots!
texts.CHK.prelandingckl.08: Copilot's armrest, if installed: check tilted upright and locked!
texts.CHK.quickavionicsckl.01: Quick start additional preflight checks, avionic checks!
texts.CHK.quickavionicsckl.02: Avionic checks. Avionics master one and two switches: on!
texts.CHK.quickavionicsckl.03: L A V C S: pilot or passenger as required!
texts.CHK.quickavionicsckl.04: Communication and navigation equipment: on and check!
texts.CHK.quickavionicsckl.05: Navigation equipment: check heading indication consistent with the M F D, true or magnetic!
texts.CHK.quickavionicsckl.06: All other instruments and equipment: check and set!
texts.CHK.quickheating2ckl.02: Cockpit fan: verify operation. Feel the airflow by hand at the demisting or instrument panel outlet!
texts.CHK.quickheating2ckl.04: Generator amps: verify decrease, only if the electrical heater is installed!
texts.CHK.quickheating2ckl.05: Cockpit fan: verify it stops. Feel the airflow by hand!
texts.CHK.quickheatingckl.02: Heating system check. Deselect DEFOG DEMIST!
texts.CHK.quickheatingckl.03: On the VMS page press NUM!
texts.CHK.quickheatingckl.05: Heating: set to maximum and check it is on! Check and remember the generator amps!
texts.CHK.quickheatingckl.07: Battery amps: verify increase by approximately 30 amps, only if the electrical heater is installed!
texts.CHK.quickheatingmenuckl.01: Heating system check, choose an option!
texts.CHK.quickpoweroffckl.01: Quick start additional preflight checks, power off!
texts.CHK.quickpoweroffckl.02: Preparation for power off. Optional equipment: check as far as possible!
texts.CHK.quickpoweroffckl.03: Avionics master one and two switches: off!
texts.CHK.quickpoweroffckl.05: Helicopter: ensure that settings or conditions are not interfered with until the quick start up is necessary!
texts.CHK.quickpoweroffckl.06: Quick start preflight checks complete. Helicopter ready for the quick start up.
texts.CHK.quickprep1ckl.02: Note! Wait 30 seconds after battery off. Instrument mode switch: day, night or N V G!
texts.CHK.quickprep1ckl.03: Battery master switch: on and engage. Allow approximately 20 seconds for the system to boot!
texts.CHK.quickprep1ckl.04: F N D master list: acknowledge. Check power up test OK!
texts.CHK.quickprep1ckl.05: Above 35 degrees and I F R: instrument panel fan on!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.01: Quick start additional preflight checks, part 2!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.02: Note! Once a day. Test fire 1: E X T. Bottles used, audio tone!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.03: Test fire 1: E X T plus warning. Check engine 1 fire, bottles test, tone, warning unit lights!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.04: Test fire 1 off. No active light on emergency off!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.05: Test fire 2: E X T. Bottles used, audio tone!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.06: Test fire 2: E X T plus warning. Same, engine 2 fire!
texts.CHK.quickprep2ckl.07: Test fire 2 off. No active light on emergency off!
texts.CHK.quickprep3ckl.01: Quick start additional preflight checks, part 3!
texts.CHK.quickprep3ckl.02: Test switch: lamp, hold. Check all lights, audio test, train, A P C P, exit lights!
texts.CHK.quickprep3ckl.04: On the V M S page press NUM!
texts.CHK.quickprep3ckl.05: Center M F D: check voltage above 23.5 volts, check fuel quantity!
texts.CHK.quickprep3ckl.06: Weight computation: adjust weight as required, press VAL, then press PREV!
texts.CHK.quickprep3ckl.07: Check master list messages and rotor brake extinguished. No start with the brake engaged!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.01: Quick start additional preflight checks, part 4!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.02: Flight instruments: aligned, set baro pressure if required!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.03: I E S I: set baro pressure if required!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.04: Trim release, hold. Check free movement, full travel. Low N R tone with collective up!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.05: Center the cyclic using the stick position indicator!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.08: External lights anticollision switch: set as required!
texts.CHK.quickprep4ckl.09: I R flash switch, if installed: set as required!
texts.CHK.quickprep5ckl.01: Quick start additional preflight checks, part 5!
texts.CHK.quickprep5ckl.02: Preparation for night flight. Choose an option, the checklist waits for it!
texts.CHK.quickprep5ckl.03: Emergency shed bus switch on. Check the message!
texts.CHK.quickprep5ckl.04: Fixed and search light landing lights: check function, set as required!
texts.CHK.quickprep5ckl.05: Emergency shed bus switch: norm and guard!
texts.CHK.shutdown2ckl.02: When the rotor has stopped, external lights anticollision switch: off!
texts.CHK.shutdown2ckl.03: M F D V M S: check the flight report page!
texts.CHK.shutdown2ckl.05: F N D master list: check download in progress disappeared, check download complete. Allow the data download to complete before switching the battery master off!
texts.CHK.shutdownckl.04: Engine one and two main switches: idle. Wait 30 seconds for the engines to cool down!
texts.CHK.shutdownckl.05: M F D four: select the V M S page!
texts.CHK.shutdownckl.06: All consumers: off, except the external lights anticollision switch!
texts.CHK.shutdownckl.07: Engine one and two main switches: off!
texts.CHK.shutdownckl.08: T O T and N 1: monitor decrease!
texts.CHK.shutdownckl.09: Rotor brake, if required: apply below 50 percent N R!
texts.CHK.startupckl.02: Instrument mode switch: Set DAY, Night or NVG as required!
texts.CHK.startupckl.03: Battery Master Switch: Set Engage then On!
texts.CHK.startupckl.05: Pilot and copilot doors, verify position and properly latched!
texts.CHK.startupckl.06: FND Master list: Acknowledge ML and check POWER UP TEST OK!
texts.CHK.startupckl.07: Anticollision lights: set as required (for engine starting, set ON)!
texts.CHK.takeoffckl.03: N2 and NR. Check at or above 101 percent.
texts.CHK.takeoffckl.05: Hover power. Check at four feet skid height.
texts.CHK.takeoffckl.06: All warnings and cautions, master list. Check off.
texts.CHK.takeoffprocckl.02: Hover: perform with 4 feet skid height!
texts.CHK.takeoffprocckl.03: Acceleration: nose down, power up smoothly. 30 knots at 15 feet!
texts.CHK.takeoffprocckl.04: At 50 knots: hold to 50 feet, then V Y!
texts.CHK.takeoffprocckl.05: N 2 and N R: check nominal decrease above 60 knots!
